item.title: Trump administration makes another appeal to the Supreme Court to allow mail ballot restrictions
item.description: The Trump administration is renewing its appeal to the Supreme Court to allow new restrictions on mail ballots in time for the midterms

item.title: Armed man charged toward Democratic candidate for Ohio governor at fair, law enforcement says
item.description: The Ohio State Highway Patrol says an armed assailant charged toward the Democratic candidate for Ohio governor, Amy Acton, during a campaign stop at the Canfield Fair, injuring several people before he was stopped by troopers

item.title: For New York's Haitian community, annual West Indian Day Parade means more in trying times
item.description: Brooklyn’s Eastern Parkway will buzz with steel drums and flag-draped floats on Monday during the West Indian Day Parade

item.title: Federal investigators probe Amazon cargo jet's fiery runway crash that killed 5 in Miami
item.description: Experts say federal investigators will likely consider whether an Amazon cargo jet that barreled off a runway and crashed into several vehicles in Miami touched down too late

item.title: Party's over for crypto scammers who went on a spending spree after a $240 million bitcoin theft
item.description: A 22-year-old man from Singapore is expected to plead guilty this week in Washington to orchestrating one of the largest cryptocurrency thefts in U.S. history, duping a stranger out of bitcoin worth over $240 million

item.title: Storm creates huge waves and dangerous currents at southern California beaches
item.description: Hurricane Marie is creating dangerous conditions at beaches across Southern California over Labor Day weekend, with strong currents and huge waves presenting a threat to swimmers and surfers
